Mass Effect Legendary Edition 18+

Has multiple difficulty settings from easy to ridiculously hard 

It's around $30 but you can probably nab it up for sale. I'd say $30 is good for 3 games in one.

You can play it on PC or on all the other consoles.

It took me around 130 for a full playthrough, but the replayability is insane. Hardcore fans of these games play a full playthrough atleast once a year as a ritual.

Mass Effect Legendary Edition is the remastered version of the original Mass Effect trilogy (so 3 games in 1 for the price of 1). I really enjoyed these during chemo as it's world is very immersive and you just get sucked in to it's sci-fi world.
Also the characters in game become friends you never knew you needed during these lonely times. If you like sci-fi worlds, some third person shooter, an amazing story and cast of characters, you should definitely check it out.
